reliability_register.mechanism: Factory PCV diagrams document check-valve, external trap and multiple hose flow paths; leaks may contribute to DTCs, but no single code identifies the failing component.
reliability_register.diagnosis: Inspect individual oil-trap hoses, clips, boost check valve and intake leaks, alongside other DTC causes and actual operating data.
reliability_register.correction: Correct the specifically diagnosed leak or damaged part with year/VIN-verified factory parts and service procedure.
limits: No code provides standalone confirmation of PCV failure.
No evidence of fleet incidence or approved retrofit.
Factory web text describing 'new' PCV in 2007/2009 is copied from design context, not proof of annual redesigned hardware.

reliability_register.mechanism: Saab distinguishes FA57 gearbox code/manufacture data and TCM hardware from vehicle chassis boundaries; campaign applicability is not established by model year alone.
reliability_register.diagnosis: Record real VIN body and chassis suffix, installed gearbox type designation, transmission-fluid history and cooler replacement invoices; obtain professional contamination testing when evidence warrants.
reliability_register.correction: Resolve applicability and condition; verified coolant/ATF mixing under TA440-0702 requires trained transmission repair evaluation, not routine fluid-only treatment.
limits: No gearbox swap or TCM programming approval.
The 'up to VIN below' test is a strict cutoff and differs from separate CSP15446 campaign inclusion.
Do not use the bulletin's open-flame ATF sample demonstration as a DIY test.

reliability_register.mechanism: The original manual prescribes interim 5,000-mile oil and filter changes for specified severe-use patterns, alongside service indicator normal reminders.
reliability_register.diagnosis: Compare dated mileage records, driving use, appropriate original factory oil grade and physical car condition; do not infer healthy bearings from a current clean dipstick.
reliability_register.correction: Create a conservative, vehicle-specific maintenance plan grounded in original service recommendation; actual lubricant product equivalence requires current approval evidence.
limits: Factory recommendation is not proof that 5,000-mile servicing guarantees a Toyota-level lifespan.
Applicable to 2008 US/CA manual conditions, not an all-years maximum or universal oil standard.
Existing internal sludge or bearing damage cannot be reversed by changing oil.

reliability_register.mechanism: Factory describes a dedicated sump procedure for B235R with manual gearbox, while independent parts catalogue reports overlapping PCV numbering and engine-number-specific hoses.
reliability_register.diagnosis: Record installed engine stamping and transmission, preserve dedicated B235R manual service access, confirm PCV hardware by manufacturer EPC and physical dimensions before disassembly or ordering.
reliability_register.correction: Use factory year/engine/gearbox-specific repair procedures, not generic sump instructions or a vendor claim alone.
limits: A factory repair procedure does not establish that the vehicle needs invasive inspection.
No ECU calibration or unrelated engine retrofit endorsed.
Supplier references and kit bundles do not approve interchange.

reliability_register.mechanism: Multiple sludge/chain-noise causes.
reliability_register.diagnosis: Measure pressure; inspect strainer and bearings as indicated. Tensioner extension over 15 mm requires chain work.
reliability_register.correction: Clean oil system, repair measured damage, fit ventilation kit and specified oil.
limits: Symptom-led procedure; PCV update does not certify prior damage absent.

reliability_register.mechanism: Revised ventilation can increase oil consumption at high rpm/low load.
reliability_register.diagnosis: Confirm campaign involvement; not every VIN in range qualifies.
reliability_register.correction: Fit oil trap 55558696; specified early engine numbers also need hose 5961610; secure hoses.
limits: Market list not retrieved.
Additional hose applies to engine numbers 4000000–4017590.

reliability_register.mechanism: Hose can detach from throttle body at certain loads.
reliability_register.diagnosis: Check CSP15435 completion and hose retention.
reliability_register.correction: Fit clip 90490543 and cable tie 7971864.
limits: Not every car in VIN interval affected.

reliability_register.mechanism: Electrical overload can fail the ignition module.
reliability_register.diagnosis: Inspect module serial: D000000–D336210 or B083821–B096117.
reliability_register.correction: Replace affected module with specified T7 unit; other serials are not replaced under this MI.
limits: Also covers 9400 B205/B235 and separate B308 population; does not cover 9440 B207.
Verify actual VIN/recall completion.

reliability_register.mechanism: Quick-coupling O-ring can move and be damaged during fitting, admitting coolant to ATF.

reliability_register.mechanism: SPNA advisory identifies premature intake valve face wear as a possible explanation for severe cold compression loss that improves once hot.

Cold/hot psi examples in secondary reproductions are inconsistent and are not a go/no-go threshold here.

reliability_register.mechanism: Saab TA440-0702 attributes coolant contamination to insufficient sealing at cooler nipples in specifically listed early FA57 9-3s.
reliability_register.diagnosis: Check year/body/VIN and campaign history, determine whether ATF is contaminated by a qualified shop and separate fluid level faults from coolant ingress. DO NOT perform the bulletin's open-flame sample heating test as a home check.

limits: FA57 advice includes body-specific MY2003–05 VIN boundaries and is broader than the separate older CSP15446 campaign.
A poor shift or ATF level error alone does not prove coolant in the transmission.
No broad application to AF40, manual transaxles, or all MY2005 cars.

reliability_register.mechanism: Original dated Saab Automobile USA reference archive has explicitly titled MY2005 and MY2006 tables while several WIS mirror year directories previously held contradictory model-year text or sample characters.

reliability_register.correction: Treat 2005 year code 5, 2006 code 6, gearbox position 7 and engine position 8 as source-scoped identity candidates, not a replacement approval. Original 2008/09 complete tables remain unverified.
limits: The PDF still lacks separately dated 2008 and 2009 original-year pages.
A VIN engine code denotes original equipment and does not prove a swapped engine's actual identity.

reliability_register.mechanism: Saab Parts USA issued a conditional parts-service kit requiring salvage and inspection of black lower switch sliding mechanism from original ISM; new electronics alone are insufficient if the mechanical section is damaged.

limits: Kit page specifies original 9-3 MY2003–2011 only; do not apply to OG9-5 TWICE and key system.
Not a VIN-specific current availability guarantee.
Requires retaining serviceable original black housing, not a complete direct replacement.

reliability_register.mechanism: Saab original 2008 9-5 mount-left WIS requires different centre nut tightening torque through 73514478 versus from 73514479, with separate manual/automatic mounting torques.
reliability_register.diagnosis: Confirm actual original 17-digit VIN/build, stamped hardware and full service-joint identity; apply only matching factory repair revision with competent repair procedure.
reliability_register.correction: Capture production cutoff as a service distinction, not a claimed new mount SKU, successor part or direction of interchange.
limits: Printed VIN value is abbreviated threshold and not a full VIN.

Service fastener specification is not a structural-rust/jacking clearance criterion.

reliability_register.mechanism: Temperature-dependent lockup, TORQUE LIMIT and P0218 can reflect actual overheating; separate P0711/12/13 concern temperature-sensor signals.

reliability_register.correction: Address confirmed cooling, fluid, sensor or wiring condition; only consider overhaul/complete replacement with evidence of internal damage, recurrence, or qualified transmission diagnosis.
limits: Protective thresholds are not recommended operating temperatures or a way to force a fault for testing.
Sensor DTC is not itself proof of thermal damage.
No factory replacement authorization or current ATF compatibility established.

reliability_register.mechanism: Separate DTC pages describe invalid range switch code combinations (P0705, MY2008) or missing output shaft sensor signal (P0722, MY2009).

reliability_register.correction: Correct confirmed selector/speed electrical fault when repairable; refer persistent mechanical ratio/contamination evidence for specialized inspection.

reliability_register.mechanism: The bulletin printed in the MY2007 web directory was originally dated January 2002 for non-US/CA 9-5 B205E/B235E; earlier dataset wrongly generalized its symptom webpage.

reliability_register.mechanism: Missing valid crankshaft position pulses may result from CPS, connector, wiring or related measurement faults.

reliability_register.correction: Repair confirmed fault, without asserting every P0336/P0337 requires replacement sensor.

reliability_register.mechanism: Missing IDM main-relay power or wiring faults can interrupt ignition and feedback synchronization.

reliability_register.diagnosis: Read TCM DTC, actual temperature and solenoid assignment, verify matched physical gearbox/TCM, perform qualified resistance and wiring tests before considering internal hydraulic damage.
reliability_register.correction: Repair a proven electrical/signal or valve-body fault where feasible; do not automatically rebuild the transmission or assume new solenoid cures worn clutches.

5.1–5.5 descriptive range versus 5.0–5.6 technical table not evidence of redesign.

reliability_register.mechanism: 440-2181 concerns OG9-3 and 440-2182 OG9-5 MY1998–99 with Dexron III ATF; later OG9-5 FA57 Saab 3309 is a different original service specification.
reliability_register.diagnosis: Read original car/platform/year/market and bulletin number, separately identify gearbox and current original WIS ATF grade. Do not generalize early four-speed fault remedies to later FA57.
reliability_register.correction: Use 2005–09 FA57 source-specific Saab 3309 documentation and matching TCM/gearbox diagnosis; preserve early bulletins only for their actual populations.
limits: Neither bulletin authorizes Dexron III in MY2005–09 FA57.
Ground points G41S/G41P/G43 are MY1998–99 bulletin only.

reliability_register.mechanism: November 2004 all-market factory bulletin documents many misdiagnosed turbo returns and directs diaphragm, wastegate, hose, vacuum and compressor condition checks.
reliability_register.diagnosis: Capture ECU/hardware/software identification, codes, then independently verify bypass seal, wastegate actuation, relevant vacuum circuit and charge-air hose leaks; evaluate actual shaft/wheel damage only using corrected factory source and exact turbo specification.
reliability_register.correction: Repair confirmed boost control, leaks or actuator separately. Order mechanical turbo only after evidence of internal damage and verified current OE configuration.
limits: All markets bulletin 291-2494 (November 2004) is NOT the restricted non-US/CA B205E/B235E E-clip bulletin 291-2317 (January 2002).
Shaft play line 'axial up/down' is internally inconsistent; 1–2mm MUST NOT be used as an acceptance criterion.
The WIS /1998/ mirror path is not the November 2004 bulletin effective date.

reliability_register.mechanism: Factory adaptation procedure follows automatic transmission, TCM or software service; TCM uses durable learning that may mask wear and survive battery disconnect.
reliability_register.diagnosis: Compare original gearbox/engine TCM programming, repairs, actual ATF temperature and codes. Reproduce only in controlled, safe, roadworthy circumstances.
reliability_register.correction: After correctly matched repairs, qualified technician performs full Tech 2 adaptation. Do not indiscriminately reset or use stall testing to warm unit.
limits: Not proof that an adaptation reset cures physical clutch/valve-body damage.
Factory explicitly forbids warming transmission with a stall test.
Availability of modern Tech 2/SPS security and software has not been established.

reliability_register.mechanism: P0717 in MY2005 relates to lost input sensor with output-speed fallback, while MY2009 P0735 means a calculated 5th-gear ratio diverges beyond 20%.
reliability_register.diagnosis: Check actual year-specific code and criteria plus TCM live input/output data, selector/ATF status, harness and vehicle-specific failure symptoms; avoid conflating missing signal with positive ratio mismatch.
reliability_register.correction: Repair confirmed sensor/harness error when established. If true ratio slip persists, evaluate transmission internals and cost before purchase.
limits: P0735 is not a confirmed worn clutch without further diagnosis.
P0717 is not guaranteed to be only a cheap electrical fix.
2005 and 2009 diagnostic source year differences are preserved.

reliability_register.mechanism: 2008 rotor removal/refit page states 4 Nm both for rotor lock screw and caliper retaining fastener; 2008 dedicated brake joint table specifies 140 Nm+45° for front caliper and 4 Nm only for small rotor screw.
reliability_register.diagnosis: Stop torque service if the joint cannot be positively identified. Match physical fastener and manufacturer torque table, review safety-critical discrepancy with knowledgeable specialist and original source before fastening.
reliability_register.correction: Database blocks promoting 4 Nm as a front caliper carrier bolt torque. Preserve both readings with explicit cross-source conflict until authoritative revision confirms procedure.
limits: No assumption that any vehicle was actually incorrectly torqued.
Only MY2008 original 9-5 procedure independently sourced.
4 Nm is the actual small rotor screw specification; never label both joints the same.

reliability_register.mechanism: 9-5 MY2009 brake-configuration chart lists B1 front 288x25 and B2 308x25; MY2006 front rotor technical page lists standard 285x25 and heavily laden 308x28, and heavy min 22 despite new 28.
reliability_register.diagnosis: Inspect actual hub rotor diameter/thickness and installed caliper carrier, identify original B1/B2/B3 configuration and year/market/engine using Saab EPC before ordering; preserve original source conflict.
reliability_register.correction: No OEM approval from dimensions or generalized trim alone. Obtain Saab part-build record/revision or in situ documented compatibility before safety-critical parts purchase.
limits: 2006 and 2009 figures are not demonstrated interchangeable or necessarily for identical original options.
No original Saab EPC VIN-specific brake part ID accessed.
Do not silently choose or average conflicting safety-critical numbers.

reliability_register.mechanism: MY2006 level 1–4 rotor sizes and caliper piston types are paired with VIN plate positions 7–10 and multiple different pads and holders; parts vary even within the same market/year.
reliability_register.diagnosis: Photograph bottom VIN option row 7–10, compare front/rear rotor diameter, thickness, rear venting, caliper type FNG/FNRG/FNC and holder, with actual vehicle condition; check wheel and brake pipe routing.
reliability_register.correction: Replace only proven level-compatible original hardware, manufacturer-approved kit or professionally engineered solution; document all dependencies before fitment.
limits: Source does not include current OEM part numbers or approved cross-level upgrades.
Painted calipers or an Aero badge aren't sufficient classification.
VIN options may not represent swapped hardware.

reliability_register.mechanism: OG9-5 has independent parking shoes/adjuster accessed via rear discs, NG9-3 handbrake lever operates rear hydraulic caliper pad/piston; hydraulic lines need clear supported routing and bleeding after opening.
reliability_register.diagnosis: Identify platform and exact rear brake type, verify mechanical parking action and hose routing from factory source, assess rusted line support/condition and wheel travel.
reliability_register.correction: Follow exact system procedure, bleed/inspect hydraulic integrity after opening, and test service plus parking brakes only when vehicle is safe to road-test.
limits: No generic 9-3 parking shoe kit can be transferred to OG9-5.
A brake pedal feel observation cannot certify hydraulic safety.
Vehicle condition remains unmeasured.

reliability_register.mechanism: Catalyst may be internally damaged by severe misfire/unburned fuel or suffer flow restriction downstream; a weak engine can also have fuel, intake, ignition and turbo issues. Historic non-US bulletin is not US-market test authorization.
reliability_register.diagnosis: Capture seller chronology, original scanned DTCs freeze frames, actual engine ability to turn and any overheating/oil-pressure/misfire history; obtain independent in-scope professional converter backpressure/location assessment plus intake/ignition/fuel tests only if safe. Never equate P0420 with a blocked converter.
reliability_register.correction: No replacement plan until correct exhaust assembly, restriction and its initiating cause are confirmed, plus structural/underbody safety and total cost evaluated. Treat unknown as no-buy-budget risk if a rebuild or transmission replacement would be unaffordable.
limits: Bulletin 248-2506 is from Nov 2004, explicitly not US/CA, and its Tech2 test requires a RUNNING car; source directory /2008/ does not override market.
Exhaust hardware diagram is MY2007; specific MY2008 VIN and US emissions components not manufacturer-approved.
Do not price or diagnose a converter solely from a seller claim; no observed real vehicle data.

reliability_register.mechanism: T7 WIS identifies ignition cassette main relay/ground and crank/cam synchronization and fuel flow/air leaks as possible diagnostic branches, including faults without stored DTC.
reliability_register.diagnosis: Only collect seller history, safe battery/engine exterior checks and read-only DTC evidence until qualified mechanical condition is established; then inspect power/ground, ignition, fuel, intake as permitted. A working starter does not prove normal oil pressure or compression.
reliability_register.correction: Fix only confirmed external control or flow fault and assess engine condition before assuming cheap non-running repair. Do not substitute red Trionic T7 ignition cassette or bypass software/programming requirements.
limits: No universal 'simple no-start' probability.
No accessible test on a non-running car certifies internal engine bearings.
Fuel pressure circuits and high-voltage ignition require specialist safety precautions.

reliability_register.mechanism: Factory lists 12.4 bar minimum but requires proper isolated ignition/fuel and controlled cranking per-cylinder conditions; low readings need leakdown or internal condition evaluation.
reliability_register.diagnosis: Do not crank a hydrolocked, overheated, oil-starved or visibly damaged engine. For safe eligible vehicle use factory compression test with recorded conditions and instrument/technician; pursue leakdown, coolant/valve/timing differential as required.
reliability_register.correction: If compression/leakdown proves valve or lower-end mechanical work, price that as major internal engine risk, not a routine ignition fix.
limits: 12.4 bar is engine and MY2006 specific.
Existing intake valve campaign evidence applies to different source years/engines; do not generalize to every 2005/06 B207.
No actual compression values or car mechanical clearance observed.

reliability_register.mechanism: External transmission solenoid/sensor faults can mimic a failed gearbox; low true hot engine oil pressure can indicate oil-system damage, which oil warning lamp alone cannot screen. Distinct year-specific FA57 DTC branches already stored in prior datasets.
reliability_register.diagnosis: Use existing year-specific FA57 DTC and ATF level/condition records, oil pressure specification only under validated hot test conditions, actual VIN/transmission identity and professional condition tests; unknown transmission internals and bearings remain unknown.
reliability_register.correction: If internal ratio slip, clutch contamination, bearing wear or low controlled oil pressure is confirmed, set rebuild/replace-risk classification and require full qualified quote; no assumption of easy solenoid or cooler repair.
limits: References earlier FA57 diagnostics and 2005/09 adaptation in existing datasets; source IDs here only establish 2009 engine oil pressure and ECU evidence.
Does not extend 2003–05 NG9-3 FA57 coolant campaign to 9-5.
No road-test, full-throttle stall test or hot idling until engine safety confirmed.

reliability_register.mechanism: WIS separately documents body captive nuts, rear frame member section boundaries, welded wagon rear floor/reinforcement, and suspension subframe bushes; these are mechanically distinct repair paths.
reliability_register.diagnosis: On a known-safe professional lift, separately inspect rear subframe tube/arms, bushes, captive nut seats and surrounding floor, rear frame members, sill/wheelhouse, brake and fuel pipes, with photos and shop assessment of sectioning/geometry if suspect.
reliability_register.correction: Replace only verified serviceable bolt-on components when structurally sound body anchors are confirmed. Escalate thinning/cracks near frame members or suspension mounts for qualified structural estimate; unknown mount integrity blocks purchase-safety clearance.
limits: MY2006 factory procedure is NOT independently proven to cover the exact MY2008 wagon in question.
No numeric Saab rust-depth rejection threshold or failure frequency.
A repair procedure is not evidence it is inexpensive, safe with weakened body metal, or straightforward DIY.

reliability_register.mechanism: Convertible sill/floor reinforcements and a rear chassis reinforcement require structural alignment and special joining; rear subframe service touches multiple safety systems.
reliability_register.diagnosis: Record photos of the inner/centre/outer sill and junctions, roofless chassis reinforcements, rear subframe body bolts, adjacent lines and lifting integrity; qualified body inspection is needed for any suspected load-bearing loss.
reliability_register.correction: Factory describes complex structural repairs, but approval to repair depends on confirmed material/geometry and capable specialist. Do not use sedan reinforcement plan or cosmetic patch as substitute.
limits: MY2006 CV procedures not an all-year 9440 collision-repair blanket approval.
No penetrative inspection, thickness measurement, repair quote or car photos reviewed.

reliability_register.mechanism: NYS DMV examines chassis/frame cracks and severe rust at suspension attachment points, brake lines for leaks/chafing/support, and fuel leaks causing drips/pooling. WIS shows fuel/handbrake/exhaust routing near subframes.
reliability_register.diagnosis: Without driving or unsafe lifting, document visible indications; have a certified NYS inspection station or suitable specialist evaluate suspension attachment metal and brake/fuel routing. Stop if any leak or severe structural question remains.
reliability_register.correction: Repair proven hydraulic/fuel/structural defects to applicable factory procedures; re-inspect. Do not issue an inspection pass, legal guarantee or structural thickness approval from photos alone.
limits: NYS page describes minimum inspection checklist, not a complete vehicle engineering study.
A car might pass minimum inspection yet have costly corrosion outside the limited zones.
No observed vehicle data or measured leakage.

reliability_register.mechanism: NHTSA's VIN lookup typically excludes safety recalls over 15 years old, completed campaigns and non-safety coverage.
reliability_register.diagnosis: Verify historical year/model recall campaigns separately, secure manufacturer/authorized service VIN completion information if available, and document actual parts/repairs.
reliability_register.correction: Never mark a vehicle recall-clear from a negative public VIN lookup alone; keep unknown until individually verified.
limits: No specific VIN searched
No actual campaign result or guarantee of ongoing parts availability

reliability_register.mechanism: Factory SID can be reset without performing service, and the displayed message can reset automatically after repeated presentation.
reliability_register.diagnosis: Review maintenance documents, fluid identification and actual inspection; compare source-scoped US/CA service schedule to elapsed time and mileage.
reliability_register.correction: Treat unknown overdue maintenance as inspection/service work for the purchase budget, without assuming engine or transmission is healthy.
limits: Vehicle could have received undocumented work
Do not run a damaged nonrunning car to force SID reading

reliability_register.mechanism: Saab original FMVSS201 upper occupant-impact noncompliance led to campaign E080101 / NHTSA 08V160.
reliability_register.diagnosis: Check original 08V160 campaign eligibility for VIN and request documented prior authorized installation of updated A-pillar trim.
reliability_register.correction: Refer unverified vehicle to qualified Saab/GM support; do not guess from trim appearance or mark complete using a model-year label.
limits: VIN status not retrieved
No physical trim inspected
No 2026 inventory or remedy appointment established

reliability_register.mechanism: Driver frontal airbag inflator rupture risk identified in original GM 16V063 safety recall.
reliability_register.diagnosis: Confirm exact VIN applicability and whether manufacturer records show completion; account for GM campaign 15041/15043 registration-history distinctions.
reliability_register.correction: Arrange authorized recall repair if applicable and outstanding; do not dismantle or attempt independent airbag exchange.
limits: No real candidate VIN status checked
No current participating shop, stock or coverage independently verified

reliability_register.mechanism: Driver seatbelt retractor tensioning cable may break on MY2004–11 9-3 convertibles.
reliability_register.diagnosis: Identify actual body style and VIN, verify relevant USA 14V318 or Canadian 2014228 service completion before treating belt as safe.
reliability_register.correction: Use authorized service campaign process and actual part/VIN application, not generic NG9-3 replacement assumption.
limits: No individual VIN checked
Does not cover all sedans
No current part supply confirmed

reliability_register.mechanism: Original factory MY2008 service checklist at 60,000 miles calls for automatic gearbox fluid change while annual-service additional work specifies 70,000 miles / 5 years.
reliability_register.diagnosis: Record both source documents and obtain specific owner's service booklet, factory revision/errata and known transmission maintenance history; do not choose the later threshold as verified just because it is in annual list.
reliability_register.correction: Treat service timing as unresolved in database; a qualified conservative service plan can be decided with actual gearbox identity, fluid specification, current condition and credible records, but must not be described as the definitive factory interval.
limits: Not a certified 2026 vehicle maintenance plan
No gearbox/VIN checked
No source-proven reason for contradictory original checklist mileages

reliability_register.mechanism: SaabWISOnline workshop directory year 2009 hosts a VIN table explicitly saying A=2010 and only 5-door/K-L trim; the named year and in-document production mapping disagree.
reliability_register.diagnosis: Read actual body stamped and windshield VIN, establish official registration/title data, then verify correct original factory VIN definition and build through authoritative Saab WebEPC.
reliability_register.correction: Do not use the 2009 WIS-mirrored VIN table as MY2009 decoder; retain year-mapping gap until proper primary source is recovered.
limits: The source mismatch does not establish a fraudulent VIN or that a real 2009 car is not authentic.
Directory 2009 is NOT publication/model-year authority for the page.
No vehicle VIN was provided or decoded.

reliability_register.mechanism: Saab factory 9440 manuals distinguish FA57 five-speed automatic, AF40 six-speed automatic, and F40 six-speed manual plus multiple 5MT coding variants; chassis options determine front strut side/parts.
reliability_register.diagnosis: Record VIN, original body/engine type and physical transmission type stamping, TCM hardware/software identity and suspension code row; validate current Saab WebEPC for exact sides and revisions.
reliability_register.correction: Apply model-specific transmission fluid and service procedure only after physical identification. Do not approve a part interchange without OE manufacturer filter, interfaces and software/hardware compatibility.
limits: Year folder 2006 AF40 type page refers to MY2005; this is documentation existence, not universal MY2006 population.
Historical GM part 13106944 on AF40 tag example is not a replacement fitment approval.
Suspension code row alone is not a unique left/right part number.

reliability_register.mechanism: A non-US/CA factory bulletin of January 2002 concerns some B205E/B235E vehicles whose wastegate pushrod clip detached. Separate 2007-indexed WIS bypass and boost tests address other causes; model-year directory alone must not widen bulletin eligibility.
reliability_register.diagnosis: Check warm-exhaust safety; record T7 DTCs/actual pressure, visually inspect linkage, bypass diaphragm and correctly isolated charge-air plumbing with relevant year WIS.
reliability_register.correction: Repair confirmed linkage, hose or bypass valve first; reserve turbo replacement for independently demonstrated turbo failure.
limits: The factory wastegate clip bulletin is 291-2317 January 2002, specifically non-US/CA B205E/B235E. It is not a universal MY2007 or B235R/US/CA fitment approval.
MY2005 pressure leak test is not automatically valid in MY2007.
No turbine shaft-bearing acceptance value or car-specific turbo diagnosis established.

reliability_register.mechanism: Factory TSB 440-2497 differentiates software/TCM, sensor, servo and modified valve body causes from internal failure.
reliability_register.diagnosis: Map exact MY2002–04 symptom to TSB row, vehicle VIN/gearbox serial and TCM software, fluid, DTC, electrical and adaptation evidence.
reliability_register.correction: Follow specific TSB first-stage correction; replace complete transmission only when factory escalation, damage or persistent failure warrants it.
limits: Not a verified universal 2005–09 bulletin.
Part 5449780 is a MY2002–03 candidate, not global retrofit.
Actual internal wear might still demand overhaul.

reliability_register.mechanism: Saab DTC documentation includes P0748 pressure-control electrical current and P0722 missing output speed, with transmission limp-home.
reliability_register.diagnosis: Check code criteria, all systems and harness, match installed ATF inspection method; distinguish sensor electrical failures from actual gear slipping.
reliability_register.correction: Address confirmed circuit/fluid faults and retest. Rebuild only if physical internal damage or persistent factory-diagnosed fault.
limits: MY2006 P0730 has independent source-year and is not the same DTC.
No guarantee electrical repair cures internal damage.
Never disable safety interlocks for testing.

reliability_register.mechanism: Factory specifies separate thermostat, coolant cap and gauge thresholds plus thermostat housing grounds and seals.
reliability_register.diagnosis: Shut down an overheating engine. When cold, inspect leaks, coolant quality and thermometer/scan data; perform professional system pressure or combustion-gas test if supported.
reliability_register.correction: Replace only confirmed external faulty part; if head warp, oil contamination, low compression or persistent blow-by is verified, evaluate major engine repair.
limits: Factory nominal temperatures do not identify head-gasket failure.
No proven non-invasive test guarantees engine health.
Do not run an overheated engine for a diagnostic drive.

reliability_register.mechanism: Factory engine control module is a programmable processor-based control system; independent specialists clone vehicle program/security data when original can be read.
reliability_register.diagnosis: Perform original WIS power/ground/network/ECM diagnosis and determine if original communicates and data is recoverable before donor purchase or cloning.
reliability_register.correction: Verify programming support and donor compatibility by VIN; one quoted vendor requires functioning communication with original and both ECUs in hand.
limits: No universal T8 ECU failure frequency proven
Seller services are not manufacturer-approved interchange
A non-communicating module may have separate more complex solutions that have not been studied

reliability_register.mechanism: Saab WIS distinguishes discrete ignition discharge module service from replacement of entire ECM, and manufacturer service support continues through part 32022255.
reliability_register.diagnosis: Use factory extended Trionic 7 ignition discharge module diagnostics before parts ordering.
reliability_register.correction: Cassette replacement follows original factory mechanical installation and seal/connector requirements; check exact VIN application and supply.
limits: No inferred failure frequency or life expectancy
Not a complete Trionic 7 ECM service procedure or guarantee of U.S. inventory

reliability_register.mechanism: Retailer individual part pages, diagram views and web-indexed snapshots can differ in quantity, shipping location or age of content.
reliability_register.diagnosis: Confirm exact current listed SKU, estimated delivery to buyer ZIP, VIN application, hardware in package, warranty and core charge with seller before relying on stock or budget.
reliability_register.correction: Store observation date and exact source page; no permanent inventory assertion, no replacement readiness or quantitative vehicle model reliability score.
limits: Cached pages and dynamic inventory are not direct order fulfillment or contract quote
No order placed, account access or inventory guaranteed
Different catalogue source views may reflect separate warehouses or update intervals

reliability_register.mechanism: The factory-authored-looking table under WIS MY2007 displays A=2010 and 5-door-only/late trim fields, inconsistent with the year directory.
reliability_register.diagnosis: Treat year-directory VIN table as out of scope; inspect stamped actual VIN, documentation, independent year-correct factory VIN guide, Saab WebEPC build record and engine/gearbox stamping.
reliability_register.correction: Record source-year conflict and defer any part selection until the actual car's complete identity and manufacturer fitment evidence are verified.
limits: Does not prove the car VIN is invalid or counterfeit.
Do not infer the 2010 codes are MY2007 codes.
No automatic VIN decoder or part interchange approved.

reliability_register.mechanism: Saab sources assign different engine-adaptation codes to 9-5 and 9-3 FA57 examples, and different TCM engine-letter tables.
reliability_register.diagnosis: Compare original VIN/build, gearbox stamping groups, engine/bellhousing, final drive, torque converter, harness connector and TCM hardware/software by original WebEPC and WIS.
reliability_register.correction: Require explicit manufacturer supersession/application evidence or independent dimensional/system testing before any approved replacement listing.
limits: Different code examples do not, by themselves, conclusively establish mechanical incompatibility.
Same transmission family name is not evidence of cross-platform fitment.
Never rely solely on model year or a merchant listing.

supplier_offerings.warranty: Page links Lifetime Replacement Guarantee; detailed eligibility not reviewed.

repair_procedures.summary: Belt, intake/plumbing and power-steering-pump access; inspect connector seals and replace bypass O-ring; refill and check leaks.
required_consumables: Connector seal lubricant specified by WIS
Pump gasket and inspected connector seals
collateral_damage: Overheating requires separate engine diagnosis; pump replacement cannot cure head/bearing damage.

repair_procedures.summary: Coil-cover/coil removal and plug replacement; resolve torque conflict before using as an instruction.
collateral_damage: Stripped cylinder-head threads or damaged coil boots change scope/cost.

parts_bill.role: inspect and renew applicable connector seals

missing_cost_inputs: Exact VIN seal selection and included gasket
Bypass O-ring number and price
Coolant quantity/price
Tool purchase or rental
Labor quote/time
Shipping/tax/core/warranty
Verify correct T/D revision and torque
Shipping and tax
Socket/torque wrench acquisition if not owned
Professional labor quote

repair_scenarios.scope_description: Saab Parts advisory separately addresses MY2007–08 B207R and MY2009–11 B207; AERA covers broader MY2003–11 as independent industry evidence, not a factory production cutoff.
repair_scenarios.diagnosis: Cold misfire, stall or poor starting may be intake-valve face erosion despite normal hot running; requires proper differential diagnosis.
repair_scenarios.corrective_path: When loss attributable to inlet valve erosion is confirmed, Saab support identifies BioPower inlet valve 55563529; head removal, valve/seat evaluation, gasket/seals and precise cam timing required.
repair_scenarios.original_cost_basis: Eight valve-only historical advertised subtotal: genuine $314.48–$363.92, TRW candidate $102.24, as of 2026-10-14; full repair unpriced, no durability advantage proven.
missing_cost_inputs: Affected production/installed-valve VIN or engine-serial cutoff
Independent lifetime advantage vs fitted original valve
Complete local machine-shop and labor quote

repair_scenarios.scope_description: B207 chain-driven petrol four-cylinder; original procedure checked on MY2007; exact repair specification follows real engine variant.
repair_scenarios.diagnosis: Rattle or timing-related DTC must be isolated before declaring timing chain wear; these sources do not establish a year-wide defect/frequency or universal preventive interval.
repair_scenarios.corrective_path: Factory chain procedure includes timing-cover access, camshaft alignment tools, tensioner manipulation and checking phase after rotating crankshaft; separate balancer drive also exists. Not a cheap bolt-on reliability upgrade.
repair_scenarios.original_cost_basis: No credible complete timed repair quote or revision-proven kit in this batch.
missing_cost_inputs: Failure incidence relative to other B207 repairs
Exact original and revised chain/tensioner/guide part families by serial
Source-backed preventive replacement threshold

repair_scenarios.scope_description: 2003 onward B207 9440 in original Saab Parts kit catalogue; original B207 procedure read at MY2004, not V6/diesel belt pump.
repair_scenarios.diagnosis: Coolant loss or overheating is a diagnosis; no controlled claim that every original pump fails early.
repair_scenarios.corrective_path: Saab Original and GM Genuine Parts both market service SKU 12630084. WIS shows balancer-shaft drive, holder 83 96 103, seals, catalytic/turbo plumbing access—not a generic belt pump. Real boxed parts and VIN still need comparison.
repair_scenarios.original_cost_basis: Saab Parts Finland historical advertised €155 for SKU 12630084, not a US quote or shipped repair total.
missing_cost_inputs: US/CA VIN filtered official part application
Whether any factory revision measurably improves life
Actual full repair quote and specialty tool availability

repair_scenarios.scope_description: B207 petrol turbochargers vary by engine variant and year; cited charge-air pressure test is MY2009 B207 only.
repair_scenarios.diagnosis: Loss of boost need not mean turbocharger shaft damage; hoses/intercooler, charge control and actuator require differential checks.
repair_scenarios.corrective_path: MY2009 WIS tests isolated charge air circuit at about 1 bar and expects no more than 0.1 bar loss over 30 seconds. Factory warns excessive pressure damages parts. Actuator diaphragm function has a separate WIS check.
repair_scenarios.original_cost_basis: Hose/control and turbo full part/labor quotes not established for specific car.
missing_cost_inputs: Turbo and bypass interchange by B207E/L/R, year and VIN
Which retrofit materials or aftermarket boost controls have proven life benefit
Known incidence and complete repaired-unit cost

repair_scenarios.scope_description: B207 9440 petrol, year and hardware-specific; do not import original 9-5 T7 B205/B235 PCV campaign 55561200.
repair_scenarios.diagnosis: PCV hose/crankcase leaks or inadequate oil history are different from diagnosed bearing damage; no blanket T7 retrofit approved for Trionic 8 B207.
repair_scenarios.corrective_path: Inspect and repair the B207 crankcase-ventilation check valve/hose using actual-year Saab intake-system procedure; verify year-specific oil grade and servicing volume. 2008 WIS distinguishes 6.0 L service refill from 6.75 L full system fill; these are not interchangeable quantities. Do not install the unrelated 9-5 T7 PCV renovation kit.
repair_scenarios.original_cost_basis: Full PCV hose set, oil pressure diagnostics and long-term outcome not priced.
missing_cost_inputs: Engine/year-specific PCV hose service changes and original numbers
Measured condition and long-term service records for real target vehicle

repair_scenarios.scope_description: Saab Technical Advice TA248-0336 dated December 2003, for 9440 Trionic 8; WIS folder year alone does not extend manufacturing scope.
repair_scenarios.diagnosis: The factory explicitly documents false P0606 due to T8 software, and warns that changing T8 hardware does not address that condition.
repair_scenarios.corrective_path: Saab bulletin's Tech2 erase, two short city cycles separated by ignition-off and rescan differentiates the bulletin's false-trigger case. Saab anticipated updated early-2004 software; actual installed update and present access not established.
repair_scenarios.original_cost_basis: Diagnostic tool/programming charges unquoted; ECU purchase alone is not justified by P0606.
missing_cost_inputs: Whether a specific VIN received fixed calibration
Access to authenticated correct current Saab programming software
Other causes of P0606 and independent hardware testing

repair_scenarios.scope_description: B207 T8 9440; original donor/calibration and FWD/XWD distinctions must be validated.
repair_scenarios.diagnosis: A true ECM failure requires separating power, grounds, data bus, relays, immobiliser and software causes; a plug-compatible junkyard unit is not automatically operable.
repair_scenarios.corrective_path: Independent specialists list cloning for customer-supplied original and donor modules; one $89.99 vendor requires readable original, one $75 listing has stated donor limitations. Not a factory-approved unrestricted exchange.
repair_scenarios.original_cost_basis: Historical advertised cloning service only: ~$75–$89.99; donor, electrical fault diagnosis, labor and shipping extra.
missing_cost_inputs: Real hardware-versus-software fault incidence
Viable recovery if original module unreadable
Authentic OE supported replacement and programming per VIN

repair_scenarios.scope_description: Original Saab Parts kit 32021815 for MY2003–11 ISM 12801010; specific early 4D/CV VIN cutoffs in 365-2568 for key-detector complaint.
repair_scenarios.diagnosis: Stuck key detector may leave radio/key chime active or prevent locking after key removal; broken key catch is a different early defect.
repair_scenarios.corrective_path: Saab bulletin 365-2568 identifies improvement for stuck ISM key detector starting sedan VIN 41033108 and convertible VIN 46011570, and a separately scoped broken key catch on early 4D VINs with improved component from 31007202. Rebuilt ISM service kit 32021815 reuses intact black sliding mechanism and is not an entire OEM ignition switch.
repair_scenarios.original_cost_basis: No VIN-confirmed complete fitted module/kit quote in batch.
missing_cost_inputs: Exact old/updated hardware in target car
Condition of reusable sliding mechanism
Genuine kit stock and installation labor

repair_scenarios.scope_description: Bulletin 365-2568 splits 4D and CV VIN boundaries; not blanket for all years, wagon or US-only extrapolation.
repair_scenarios.diagnosis: All remotes dead but engine starts, one remote dead, key not accepted, or SCL message have different roots and factory repair branches.
repair_scenarios.corrective_path: Original bulletin instructs update CIM software for all-remote failure to sedan VIN 41021535/CV 46006859; replace faulty remote rather than CIM for individually dead remote to sedan 41063612/CV 46019650; similar key-not-accepted branch. Factory WIS says keys already married to other cars cannot simply be reprogrammed and all keys lost requires CIM replacement by factory path.
repair_scenarios.original_cost_basis: No credible fully installed, programmed, correctly keyed module cost; do not confuse key-fob price with all-keys-lost repair.
missing_cost_inputs: Exact real-car build boundary and modules
Independent verified cheaper method with original key security access
Local specialists and delivered, configured replacement total

repair_scenarios.scope_description: TA440-0702: NG9-3 MY2003–05 Sport Sedan chassis suffix <51002378; TiD SS <51000001 separately non-US/diesel; CV <56001058. Must establish exact gearbox and vehicle VIN.
repair_scenarios.diagnosis: Insufficient sealing between oil-cooler-line nipples and cooler; when coolant enters ATF may cause poor shifting, TCM P0715/P0720 and loss requiring complete transmission replacement per original Saab advice.
repair_scenarios.corrective_path: Saab TA440-0702 after positive contamination calls for replacing entire transmission plus cooler connections, flushing lines/cooler, checking coolant contamination and TCM adaptation. Never substitute generic radiator-only fix for a confirmed contaminated gearbox.
repair_scenarios.original_cost_basis: Complete fitted gearbox and cooler repair cost not quoted; cannot assume $100 seals avoid existing gearbox damage.
missing_cost_inputs: Real VIN campaign/repair completion and physical gearbox identity
Uncontaminated original gearbox life after properly executed connection correction
Local full replacement cost and donor reliability

repair_scenarios.scope_description: FA57 actual-equipped B207 9440 and source-specific TCM fault path; do not generalize to six-speed, manual or non-FA57 units.
repair_scenarios.diagnosis: Shift symptoms may reflect fluid condition, electrical input/output speed signals, adaptation, temperature or internal damage; TA440-0702 is not the cause of every gearbox DTC.
repair_scenarios.corrective_path: Diagnose transmission and its cooler, wiring, TCM inputs and actual internal damage separately. Do not buy an untested valve body, used gearbox or software on DTC alone.
repair_scenarios.original_cost_basis: No specific vehicle labor or parts cost; cannot use average online estimates as proof.
missing_cost_inputs: Condition of actual gearbox and valve body
Proven incidence by MY/gearbox suffix
Complete correct-gearbox repair quote

repair_scenarios.scope_description: Saab US/CA special coverage 15917 bulletin 731-2726: specified NG9-3 MY2003–06 sedan/wagon/CV in named salt states including NY and Canada; not a global all-year recall.
repair_scenarios.diagnosis: Stone/gravel trapped at lower seat damages spring coating; corrosion and potential fracture causing height/handling changes.
repair_scenarios.corrective_path: Factory correction if spring fractured: both springs with model-appropriate EPC part numbers and zinc plates 12794486; professional spring compressors essential. Original special coverage 10 years/120k miles from in-service date, so generally expired by 2026 for these 2003–06 cars.
repair_scenarios.original_cost_basis: No current pair springs, struts, alignment or labor quote.
missing_cost_inputs: Original vehicle coverage history and correct EPC springs
Current rust and mount condition
Long-run durability after remedy

repair_scenarios.scope_description: 9440 sedan/wagon/CV and FWD; actual corrosion/line routing needs car, body type and original parts identity.
repair_scenarios.diagnosis: Structural rust, brake/fuel line perforation or damaged chassis attachment is an independent no-drive/no-buy concern unrelated to whether B207/FA57 can be repaired.
repair_scenarios.corrective_path: Factory WIS has subframe centering/removal and routed line service methods. Actual approved metalwork and new parts must be priced by location; a universal donor subframe swap cannot be assumed.
repair_scenarios.original_cost_basis: No local metalwork/lines/subframe complete quote; parts catalogue availability not proof exact fit.
missing_cost_inputs: Actual underbody photos/probing
Correct FWD/body-specific subframe, mounts, pipes, clips and VIN fitment
Independent professional safety assessment and realistic estimate

repair_scenarios.scope_description: North American NG9-3 9440 B207 range 2003–11; actual US VIN/year/market options and installed gearbox require original vehicle verification; 2003 old-generation convertible 9400 excluded.
repair_scenarios.diagnosis: Incorrectly assigning an FA57 bulletin to a manual/six-speed car, a GM part to the wrong installed revision, or a 2010 WIS mirror table to MY2009 can lead to expensive wrong repairs.
repair_scenarios.corrective_path: Use Saab original US year-specific VIN compilation, full car labels and independently confirmed OEM EPC build/parts lookup; treat Canada as separate unresolved mapping where primary year-specific information is missing.
repair_scenarios.original_cost_basis: Data lookup, specialist VIN decode and inspection time not quoted; mismatched gearbox can turn a proposed cheap repair into an invalid diagnosis.
missing_cost_inputs: CAN market equipment decode for each target VIN
Exact physical engine/gearbox/revision and factory affected population on seller car

repair_scenarios.scope_description: Factory NG9-3 MY2006 sample documentation for trim-dependent braking levels; no universal 2003–11 disc diameter or bolt torque.
repair_scenarios.diagnosis: Incorrect assumed brake level can cause wrongly ordered pads/rotors/calipers. Leaking or corroded lines, stuck calipers and worn discs are safety and purchase inspection risks; no universal original Saab brake design failure established by this evidence.
repair_scenarios.corrective_path: Saab WIS has option-specific procedures and rear piston rewind service tools 89 96 969/89 96 977; replace dangerous lines/pads/callipers with correctly selected new components and bleed/verify braking under workshop procedures.
repair_scenarios.original_cost_basis: No VIN-specific fitted brake set or corroded hard-line shop estimate; 4-disc kit price cannot stand in for structural brake-line repair.
missing_cost_inputs: Per-VIN option codes and actual installed caliper revisions
Local parts supply, brake-line fabrication tools and complete safe repair quote

repair_scenarios.scope_description: Each US/Canadian car's actual VIN, model year, original airbag configuration, registration and previous recall remedy; not a blanket claim every B207 is recalled.
repair_scenarios.diagnosis: Unremedied safety campaign exposure can be critical even on a mechanically good car; NHTSA's current unrepaired-recall lookup is not a complete history of all past campaigns or proof of proper previous repair.
repair_scenarios.corrective_path: Have outstanding VIN-applicable safety recalls and verified manufacturer remedies performed by authorized qualified provider before road use where safety is compromised; keep separate from other mechanical repairs.
repair_scenarios.original_cost_basis: No promise that specific historical campaigns remain free/available for all vehicles or that aftermarket restraints are approved.
missing_cost_inputs: Actual candidate VIN historical/open remedy statuses
Proof original campaign action completed and parts origin

repair_scenarios.scope_description: Factory Saab TA855-0706 February 2007 market All, cars concerned 9-3 9440; no independent affected serial cutoff in bulletin.
repair_scenarios.diagnosis: Badly applied sealant at the RH A-pillar, firewall and front fender junction can admit water into right front carpet and drain under the carpet to the rear floor; apparent rear-only wet floor may originate at front seam.
repair_scenarios.corrective_path: Factory TA855-0706 says inspect sealant both outside and inside the RH pillar firewall/fender corner, remove bad sealant, clean and reseal. Any secondary wiring/floor damage requires independent assessment.
repair_scenarios.original_cost_basis: Sealant and labor, underlay drying, harness corrosion repair and rust restoration not quoted.
missing_cost_inputs: Physical water source on chosen car and extent of secondary damage
Durability of executed sealant repair over years

repair_scenarios.scope_description: Original 9-5 MY1998–2003 B205/B235 per US/CA bulletin 210-2554 edition 3; do not assume this applies to every later B235.
repair_scenarios.diagnosis: Sludge or blocked pickup may lower oil pressure and ultimately damage bearings. An oil lamp or lower-end knocking needs diagnosis, not a PCV-only fix.
repair_scenarios.corrective_path: Separate switch/sender, pickup restriction and irreversible bearing damage; Saab's confirmed bearing-damage branch involves a replacement short block, outside the no-rebuild shopping goal.
repair_scenarios.original_cost_basis: No current complete installed short-block/engine price or confirmed safe donor.
missing_cost_inputs: Real oil pressure and bearing condition are unknown until safe tests.
PCV retrofit status and subsequent engine wear cannot be inferred from model year.

repair_scenarios.scope_description: Early B205/B235 sludge bulletin includes symptom-triggered chain evaluation; specific later model-year procedures must be independently confirmed.
repair_scenarios.diagnosis: Chain rattle, tensioner wear and obstructed oil feed require distinguishing timing service from internal bearings; chain service is not proof of engine soundness.
repair_scenarios.corrective_path: Carry out the exact timing or balance drive intervention only after excluding irreparable bottom-end damage and verifying the engine year's procedure.
repair_scenarios.original_cost_basis: No verified complete chain-kit VIN bill, labor hours or installed quote.
missing_cost_inputs: Timing damage and bearing state are distinct unresolved risks.
The early tensioner criterion is not a blanket later-year warranty or replacement schedule.

repair_scenarios.scope_description: Original early 9-5 MY1998–2003 B205/B235, US/CA symptom/case scope; do not assign to B207 or later years.
repair_scenarios.diagnosis: Restricted PCV flow and oil leaks have source-supported factory service actions, but old bearing wear survives a hose or oil-trap renovation.
repair_scenarios.corrective_path: Saab bulletin 210-2554 identifies PCV renovation kit 55561200; related 210-2417 applies to oil-leakage cases and requires separate scope matching.
repair_scenarios.original_cost_basis: Current complete original kit fulfillment and all necessary ancillary parts are unconfirmed.
missing_cost_inputs: Actual vehicle engine number and installed revision need checking.
No evidence that renovation reverses prior sludge or gives a quantified life extension.

repair_scenarios.scope_description: Original campaign CSP15433 / 210-2496 applies selected MY2004–05 B235 manual-transmission cars, with published chassis/engine restrictions and selective vehicle eligibility.
repair_scenarios.diagnosis: High oil consumption/oil-trap update is documented, but this bulletin alone does not authorize a free repair or automatic-car retrofit.
repair_scenarios.corrective_path: Factory lists replacement oil trap 55558696 and an early engine-number-dependent hose 5961610, conditional on correct vehicle eligibility.
repair_scenarios.original_cost_basis: Original kit and eligible campaign coverage for a 2026 purchase are not verified.
missing_cost_inputs: Selected-chassis eligibility cannot be derived from numeric range alone.
Factory early-engine hose condition conflicts with generic aftermarket fitment headlines.

repair_scenarios.scope_description: Original CSP15435 / 210-2508 all markets MY2004–05 B205/B235, selected chassis vehicles; separate from manual oil-trap campaign.
repair_scenarios.diagnosis: The ventilation hose can detach from its throttle-body connection, leading to an external repair path instead of speculative turbo or engine replacement.
repair_scenarios.corrective_path: Factory campaign specifies retaining tie 7971864 and clip 90490543 where criteria are met; condition and fitment must be matched before installation.
repair_scenarios.original_cost_basis: No current VIN-filtered kit availability, installed cost or life testing.
missing_cost_inputs: Exact original factory campaign status on any car remains unknown.
Subsequent hose deterioration requires separate condition inspection.

repair_scenarios.scope_description: 9-5 four-cylinder Trionic 7 with black IDM; recall 15021 has its own serial/VIN restrictions and cannot be generalized to every 9-5.
repair_scenarios.diagnosis: Misfire, no-start and combustion feedback faults could involve supply/grounds, plugs, cassette or control; red T5 cassette is not a substitute.
repair_scenarios.corrective_path: Saab/parts-channel current service candidate 32022255 exists; historical four-cylinder recall numbers include 55562588 and 55559955, but OE revision and VIN approval remain unresolved.
repair_scenarios.original_cost_basis: eSaabParts displayed $316.10 for 32022255 on 2026-10-13; supply and total repair cost unverified.
missing_cost_inputs: Individual recall eligibility and installed module revision need original documents.
Long-term cassette durability advantage and genuine live stock are unmeasured.

repair_scenarios.scope_description: Original 9-5 four-cylinder T7; pin/sensor figures from MY2006 WIS, not universally certified aftermarket fitment.
repair_scenarios.diagnosis: T7 cannot synthesize a missing crank position signal; P0337 during crank or P0336 running require sensor, wiring, connector and signal assessment.
repair_scenarios.corrective_path: Factory reference MY2006 CPS is inductive 60-2; nominal 860 ±90 ohms at 20°C is a test datum, not proof a hot-failing sensor is sound.
repair_scenarios.original_cost_basis: Specific Saab OE-number/supplier candidate and fully installed local cost not established.
missing_cost_inputs: Exact physical sensor, harness damage and year-specific DTC conditions unknown.
Electrical resistance at ambient alone is insufficient to rule out intermittent failure.

repair_scenarios.scope_description: Original 9-5 MY2006 T7 four-cylinder detailed source, supported by separately indexed later power/ground descriptions.
repair_scenarios.diagnosis: Missing +30, +15, main relay, power ground G7 or a shorted shared 5V sensor circuit can cause no ECU communication, stop or limp-home.
repair_scenarios.corrective_path: Repair verified supply, ground, relay or isolated sensor/harness faults; do not declare ECU dead merely because the scan tool cannot communicate.
repair_scenarios.original_cost_basis: Actual ECU replacement/immobilizer pairing and repair quote unknown.
missing_cost_inputs: Harness routing and exact fuse identifiers vary with year/build and must be confirmed.
A physically compatible replacement ECU still needs security/programming evidence.

repair_scenarios.scope_description: 9-5 original Trionic 7 / TWICE where equipped; programming procedure source MY2005 and authorization source MY2006.
repair_scenarios.diagnosis: Start blocked by immobilizer security mismatch or P1460 after module work; a donor control unit cannot simply be assumed plug-and-play.
repair_scenarios.corrective_path: Use correct Saab security/programming procedure and verified compatible modules; diagnose immobilizer before engine/ECU replacement.
repair_scenarios.original_cost_basis: No verified all-keys-lost specialist quote or 2026 hardware/software support guarantee.
missing_cost_inputs: Programmer access and code/data availability for individual car unresolved.
Aftermarket donor module compatibility is not established by matching plug.

repair_scenarios.scope_description: Original 9-5 turbocharged petrol covered by Saab bulletin 291-2494, issued November 2004; turbo-specific tests and parts differ by engine.
repair_scenarios.diagnosis: Saab received turbo returns where root causes were boost/bypass/actuator faults; weak power or boost DTC does not establish bad bearings or turbo.
repair_scenarios.corrective_path: Repair proved leaks, bypass or control faults first; buy correctly specified Garrett/Mitsubishi replacement only if internal turbo damage is established.
repair_scenarios.original_cost_basis: Turbo genuine/aftermarket validated VIN SKU, complete oil-line set and installed quote unverified.
missing_cost_inputs: Saab 291-2494 shaft-play phrase has ambiguous axial/radial terminology, not a valid tolerance.
GT17 vs TD04 hardware identity and replacement life not individually verified.

repair_scenarios.scope_description: Original 9-5 MY2002–04 five-speed automatic, bulletin 440-2497; several corrections target only MY2002–03.
repair_scenarios.diagnosis: Hard 2–3 shift, P–D delay, lockup slipping and intermittent hard engagement can reflect servo cover, valve housing, TCM calibration, electrical checks or real internal wear.
repair_scenarios.corrective_path: Follow bulletin branch for B4 servo, software or valve housing (e.g. 5449780 only where specified), then retest; internal loss of drive needs a whole-gearbox quote.
repair_scenarios.original_cost_basis: No whole installed transmission replacement quote, donor-case certification or repair-service guarantee.
missing_cost_inputs: Actual fault may still involve mechanical clutch or hydraulic damage.
Bulletin does not authorize MY2005–09 use of its MY2002–03 replacement housing.

repair_scenarios.scope_description: Original 9-5 later FA57: MY2005 P0717, MY2009 P0735 and TCM read values documented separately; exact year/gearbox code required.
repair_scenarios.diagnosis: A missing speed signal may have an external electrical cause; persistent calculated 5th ratio deviation can also represent real hydraulic/mechanical failure.
repair_scenarios.corrective_path: Repair proven wiring/sensor or specified hydraulic fault where feasible; for verified repeated internal slip outside scope budget installed replacement or reject.
repair_scenarios.original_cost_basis: Full gearbox quotes, internal condition, 2026 donor stock and programming unknown.
missing_cost_inputs: P0735 alone does not identify a failed specific internal component.
Read-value semantics and code definitions must be checked for exact transmission year.

repair_scenarios.scope_description: 9-5 early AF30/FA47 4AT versus later 5-speed FA57; MY2008 FA57 level hardware without dipstick, MY2005 fluid data and MY2008 US/CA schedules are separately scoped.
repair_scenarios.diagnosis: Incorrect fluid, level, shift-adaptation or donor case assumptions can produce expensive misdiagnosis; adaptation is not a cure for worn clutches.
repair_scenarios.corrective_path: Use correct original type-specific 3309-era specification, Tec​h 2 temperature-driven level/adaptation procedure where documented; reset learned adaptation after actual TCM/transmission/software work.
repair_scenarios.original_cost_basis: No full ATF change quote or verified modern approved substitute; MY2005 7.0 L total is not service drain amount.
missing_cost_inputs: Historic Saab schedules disagree and require original booklet revision to reconcile.
Donor case/TCM/software compatibility requires actual part and tag verification.

repair_scenarios.scope_description: Original 9-5 B235 petrol; MY2008 cooling source references; automatic radiator has ATF cooler connections distinct from manual.
repair_scenarios.diagnosis: Leaks, sensor/controller/fan faults and a thermostat can be repairable, but a severe overheat may damage cylinder head or bearings.
repair_scenarios.corrective_path: Factory 89±2°C thermostat, 140–150 kPa cap and controlled pressure test support diagnosing faults; retailer lists Nissens 32019620 automatic radiator referencing Saab 5193388.
repair_scenarios.original_cost_basis: Nissens 32019620 was advertised $211.98 on 2026-10-13, before fluids/ATF, hardware, shipping and installation.
missing_cost_inputs: Actual B235 head-gasket/thermal damage needs test, not year-based inference.
VIN/gearbox radiator, cooler lines and durable aftermarket superiority are not validated.

repair_scenarios.scope_description: Original 9-5 MY2008 B235 source: left-mount joint and front torque-arm tightening changes at 73514478/73514479.
repair_scenarios.diagnosis: Vibration and movement can arise from worn mounts but mount replacement is not evidence of an engine needing internal repair.
repair_scenarios.corrective_path: Factory calls for engine lifting beam 8394850 and mount alignment; chassis boundary changes specific fastener torques, not proved mount interchange.
repair_scenarios.original_cost_basis: No VIN-filtered four-cylinder mount SKU and no confirmed all-in quote.
missing_cost_inputs: Whether actual candidate mount rubber or structural anchor is defective is unknown.
Aftermarket donor variants and resilience improvements remain unverified.

repair_scenarios.scope_description: Original 9-5 (9600) front/rear and MY2006 5D wagon-specific factory body repairs; MY2008 actual candidate requires own condition confirmation.
repair_scenarios.diagnosis: Rust confined to serviceable rear subframe differs economically and structurally from corroded captive nuts, rails, rear floor, wheelhouse and suspension anchor steel.
repair_scenarios.corrective_path: Repair removable subframe/bush if body is sound, with alignment; structural rear-frame/floor repairs require factory sectioning and verified joining/alignment technique.
repair_scenarios.original_cost_basis: No physical thickness/geometry measurements, VIN-approved replacement frame, welding estimate or safe-installation quote.
missing_cost_inputs: Seller 'rear subframe rust' description has no defined structural boundary.
Body reinforcement corrosion and adjacent hydraulic lines must be examined separately.

repair_scenarios.scope_description: Original 9-5 9600 MY2006–09 source-specific brake chart and repair procedures; do not apply NG9-3 caliper design.
repair_scenarios.diagnosis: Brake leaks or rusted hardlines can make any purchase unsafe; factory 9-5 rotor dimensions/fastener text conflict, demanding exact hardware confirmation.
repair_scenarios.corrective_path: Repair failed hydraulic lines with appropriate flaring/bleeding and documented parts; MY2008 dedicated caliper table lists 140 Nm+45° carrier versus separate 4 Nm small disc screw, a documented source contradiction with prose.
repair_scenarios.original_cost_basis: No VIN-certified complete brake bill, hydraulic restoration quote or structural status.
missing_cost_inputs: 9-5 B1/B2/B3 versus year-specific dimensions conflict unresolved.
Exact brake hardware and safety standards require real inspection.

repair_scenarios.scope_description: Original MY2008 B235E/R 9-5 sedan/wagon North American emissions system; first-party architecture contains primary and main converter, not a single undifferentiated 'cat'.
repair_scenarios.diagnosis: An oxygen sensor fault, mixture/ignition failure or an actual physical restriction are different diagnoses; running rich/misfiring may damage replacement catalyst.
repair_scenarios.corrective_path: Correct proven engine control root cause and source a new legally compliant emission-certified converter for the actual car; no used/salvage catalyst shortcut in New York.
repair_scenarios.original_cost_basis: No precise lawful replacement SKU, compliant 2026 delivered stock, fitted cost or backpressure measurements.
missing_cost_inputs: Seller's converter diagnosis and whether the catalyst is actually blocked remain unproven.
New York certification/50-state emissions label and exact converter stage need verification.

repair_scenarios.scope_description: Original 9-5 B235R with exact gearbox and equipment restrictions; AS-PL S0034 starter and A0219 vs A0319 alternator supplier catalogue candidates.
repair_scenarios.diagnosis: Charging/no-crank electrical problems can be externally repairable, but shared aftermarket application lists do not certify an Opel donor or stronger alternator retrofit.
repair_scenarios.corrective_path: Manufacturer AS-PL S0034 lists 12V 1.4kW 9-tooth starter; A0219 12V 120A PL_9104 alternator differs from A0319 130A PL_9105; verify physical original and ECU charging controls.
repair_scenarios.original_cost_basis: Bosch reman starter 32101497 snapshot $194.99 on 2026-10-13; core, shipping and actual VIN compatibility unknown.
missing_cost_inputs: No genuine WebEPC cross-brand interchange approval.
Regulator/pulley geometry and verified 2026 supply for original option are missing.

repair_scenarios.scope_description: Original 9-5 MY2008 US/CA factory service schedule used as example; historical US MY2002–08 A-pillar campaign and MY2006–09 Takata program have separate populations.
repair_scenarios.diagnosis: Missing oil, brake, ATF, airbag or belt records increase uncertainty; NHTSA public VIN lookup may omit completed and older-than-15-year recalls.
repair_scenarios.corrective_path: Carry out appropriate owner-booklet maintenance and authorized outstanding safety recall remedy where eligible; MY2008 60k vs 70k/5yr ATF documents disagree and must not be silently combined.
repair_scenarios.original_cost_basis: No VIN-specific campaign result, authorized parts availability, free-coverage proof or current quotes.
missing_cost_inputs: NHTSA showing zero open recalls does not certify historic work on this old car.
Actual prior service, original market and interval errata need documents.
